solstice-cliff-villa.title: Solstice Cliffside Villa
solstice-cliff-villa.summary: Cantilevered oceanfront villa with double-height glazing, infinity pool, and seamless indoor-outdoor limestone terraces.
solstice-cliff-villa.description: Designed around uninterrupted coastal light, Solstice Cliffside Villa pairs monolithic white concrete planes with warm oak joinery and floor-to-ceiling low-iron glass. Three terraced levels step naturally toward a heated saltwater infinity pool and private sunset lounge.
features: Private wellness suite with sauna & plunge

courtyard-travertine-house.title: Courtyard Travertine House
courtyard-travertine-house.summary: Minimalist modern house organized around a tranquil reflection pond, oak timber louvers, and natural stone galleries.
courtyard-travertine-house.description: Built for quiet privacy in a lush residential enclave, this architectural house frames an interior reflection courtyard at its heart. Motorized oak louvers filter afternoon sunlight across honed travertine floors and custom gallery walls.
features: Central reflection pond & Zen garden courtyard

pinecrest-glass-pavilion.title: Pinecrest Glass Pavilion
pinecrest-glass-pavilion.summary: Elevated hillside glass pavilion suspended among mature pines with a wrap-around timber deck and fireplace lounge.
pinecrest-glass-pavilion.description: Anchored into a gentle wooded slope, Pinecrest Glass Pavilion floats quietly above the canopy. Expansive structural glass walls dissolve the boundary between the travertine living pavilion and the surrounding pine forest.

skyline-aura-penthouse.title: Skyline Aura Penthouse
skyline-aura-penthouse.summary: Full-floor sky villa featuring a private sunken terrace lounge, reflective water court, and 360-degree horizon views.
skyline-aura-penthouse.description: Occupying the entire crown of an architectural landmark, Skyline Aura Penthouse brings villa-scale proportions to elevated urban living. Private elevator access opens into a light-filled gallery extending onto a landscaped rooftop terrace.
features: Landscaped wrap-around sky terrace & sunken lounge

horizon-infinity-estate.title: Horizon Infinity Estate
horizon-infinity-estate.summary: Twilight-oriented contemporary estate featuring twin guest pavilions, sculptural water mirror, and private garden lawn.
horizon-infinity-estate.description: Conceived as a multi-generational compound, Horizon Infinity Estate pairs a dramatic main residence with two independent guest pavilions linked by covered stone colonnades and manicured reflecting pools.
features: Main residence plus two detached guest pavilions
Outdoor summer kitchen & pergola dining terrace

atrium-minimal-residence.title: Atrium Minimal Residence
atrium-minimal-residence.summary: Double-height interior sanctuary with a monolithic travertine fireplace, slatted oak ceiling, and private garden sanctuary.
atrium-minimal-residence.description: Combining urban convenience with serene residential proportions, Atrium Minimal Residence centers on a sunlit double-height living atrium. Custom bronze hardware, fluted timber paneling, and quiet courtyard glazing define every room.
features: Private landscaped rear garden & plunge pool

architecture.title: Built with Restraint, Material Honesty & Light
architecture.subtitle: We represent homes where architecture elevates daily life—favoring enduring stone, warm timber, passive orientation, and spatial calm over fleeting trends.

0.title: 01 / Material Permanence
0.desc: Honed limestone, architectural concrete, brushed bronze, and sustainably sourced oak selected to age gracefully over decades.

1.title: 02 / Daylight & Orientation
1.desc: Every floor plan is evaluated for cross-ventilation, solar shading, and calm sightlines linking interior rooms to gardens or horizon views.

2.title: 03 / Discreet Ownership
2.desc: Private gated thresholds, acoustic glazing, and verified legal due diligence ensure effortless acquisition and peaceful long-term living.
